svg.title: Painting in Five Panels
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Haus der Kunst 2011 colorinstallation image caption identifies Whitney’s Painting in Five Panels (1955). Five differently sized painted rectangles separated by transparent wall gaps. White backfields and small green lower-left wedge of central canvas retained. Relative installation spacings and small-panel details approximate; no claim of exact reinstall dimensions. Normalized to observed installation because photograph perspective and variable gaps do not securely establish orthographic spacing.
